name: 30 minutes until my brain dies
source:
When Eva boarded the ship, all she saw ahead was love, light, and vivid visions of a new life.

She didn’t know that a single moment would turn everything into hell.

Now, there’s only one way out — into endless darkness.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3896070/30_minutes_until_my_brain_dies/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
当伊娃登上船时，她看到的只是爱、光明和新生活的生动景象。

她不知道，只要一瞬间，一切就会变成地狱。

现在，只有一条出路——进入无尽的黑暗。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3896070/30_minutes_until_my_brain_dies/]Steam[/url]]
